pages.text: [#](53341a)Not a burst of growth but a sustained medium-circle coaxing, urging the land toward green abundance over time — fields, moss, saplings, and wild growth.[#]()
pages.title: Rite of Nature's Power

pages.text: [#](53341a)Worked from a medium circle with **Brew of Sprouting** and a mixed grove offering — **Rowan**, **Alder**, **Hawthorn**, **Oak**, **Spruce**, and **Birch Saplings** — plus a **Charged Attuned Stone** (returned).[#]()
pages.title: The Working

pages.text: [#](53341a)It pulses outward, greening soil and driving growth. Nearby Coven Witches lengthen its reach.[#]()
